checks: selected_theta_input and selected_lambda_input exhaust actual StepChild selection, eliminate incompatible request constructors, and identify selected arguments exactly. Z_ok_state establishes mid/pre log equality; no caller-supplied log relation or child completion assumption is needed.

Private Choice pairs each actual precompile result with the disjunction world=empty OR returned logs=input logs. Individual proofs unfold all ten pinned precompile definitions and split actual branches, including invalid input/OOG outcomes; they do not falsely assert every raw precompile result preserves logs.

precompile_choice covers every dispatcher target, including unsupported-target default result. It projects the same actual result tuple, leaving success arbitrary. World and log alternatives are coupled to that tuple, not independently chosen witnesses.

precompile_logs handles zero fuel by contradiction and rewrites the actual Theta precompiled branch into the exact dispatcher plus world/substate empty-world fallback. Its entry world and execution environment match that branch, rather than a code-execution Context.result.

On fallback, the original substate logs are returned directly. On non-fallback, the empty-world alternative is impossible by reflexivity of empty-world BEq, and the other Choice branch supplies exact original logs. This works for true or false returned status without assuming a successful precompile.
Proofs depend on structural return/world/substate choices, not cryptographic oracle validity, funded transfers, protected owner, or a desired post-log condition.
